preconditions.description: The number of hashtags is between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(hashtag.startswith('#') and hashtag[1:].islower() for hashtag in hashtags)
preconditions.description: Each hashtag starts with '#' followed by lowercase letters.
The total length of all hashtags (excluding '#') does not exceed 500,000.

postconditions.expression: all(hashtag.startswith('#') and hashtag[1:].islower() for hashtag in result_hashtags)
postconditions.description: Each resulting hashtag starts with '#' followed by lowercase letters.

postconditions.expression: all(result_hashtags[i] <= result_hashtags[i + 1] for i in range(len(result_hashtags) - 1))
postconditions.description: The resulting hashtags are in lexicographical order.

postconditions.expression: sum(len(hashtag) - 1 for hashtag in result_hashtags) <= sum(len(hashtag) - 1 for hashtag in hashtags)
postconditions.description: The total number of deleted symbols is minimized.
